title: Hassan
identity: Tilen Lebar's Hassan (2022) is an 11-minute work for prepared alto saxophone and tape/sound recording. Donemus describes it as an obligatory first-round work for SAXGO22 and documents glass-jar preparation, whistle tones, natural spectral multiphonics, microtonal polyrhythms, and very soft dynamics.

evidence.claim: Composer's Donemus work listing gives duration and instrument/media.
Donemus event description documents the SAXGO22 competition role and extended techniques.
Composer page lists Hassan, scoring, duration, and sheet music.
Academy of Music, University of Ljubljana program lists Hassan in a master's saxophone recital.
